potential_user_journeys.scenario_description: A user searches for a connector using the provided search bar to quickly locate it among the list.

steps.element_description: Search bar located at the top of the page.
Filtered list of connectors matching the search criteria.

expected_outcome: The list updates to display only connectors that match the search input.

potential_user_journeys.scenario_description: A user updates details of an existing connector to ensure accuracy or resolve configuration issues.

steps.element_description: Edit button adjacent to the connector's details.

expected_outcome: The connector's details are updated and displayed correctly.

potential_user_journeys.scenario_description: A user adds a new connector to integrate it into the Roost.ai system.

steps.element_description: Add Connector button at the top of the page.
Form fields to input connector name and type.
Save button to finalize the new connector.

expected_outcome: The new connector appears in the list with the provided details.
